author: Multiplayer Everything
name: Spooky Together

needs: Your own copy of Spooky's Jump Scare Mansion: HD Renovation on Steam, with Steam running and signed in on every PC.
Everyone you play with needs the same version of the mod. The launcher keeps yours up to date.
steps: Press Install. The launcher finds your copy of the game and puts the mod in it.
Press Launch. The game starts through Steam, which it needs.
In the game press F5 to open the multiplayer panel, then set your name and colour.

Pick Online (Steam) or LAN / direct. Online (Steam): the host presses Host on Steam; friends pick the game from the Steam games list, press Join Game on the host's Steam profile, or accept the host's invite.

LAN / direct: the host presses Host (TCP port 27020 must be reachable: forward it, or use a LAN or a VPN such as Tailscale or ZeroTier). Friends pick the host's game from the server list, or type its address and press Join.
The host starts a run from the main menu (New Game or Continue). Every friend is pulled into the same mansion.

keys.does: Opens the multiplayer panel in the game.

tips: Only the host starts a run.
If the host disconnects, the others keep playing alone: there is no host migration.
Starting the game's exe directly makes it quit and relaunch through Steam. Use Launch.
Joining over Steam has only been tested between copies on one PC so far.

description: Co-op for Spooky's Jump Scare Mansion: HD Renovation (Steam). Play the mansion with up to four friends: shared rooms, keys, items, specimens, the axe and endings, with a LAN server list. Everyone needs the same version.
